name: MacKreel's Moonshine
summary: MacKreel's Moonshine is a fast-paced errand run on behalf of Foggy MacKreel, a dwarf stranded on the broken part of the Thandol Span. Having overindulged on his own potent brew and slept through his watch, Foggy entrusts an Alliance traveler with rushing a fresh batch to Hillsbrad to settle a lingering debt with Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore.

sections.title: A Guard's Hangover
sections.body: Life on watch atop the shattered Thandol Span is wet, cold, and notoriously dull. Foggy MacKreel manages the damp chill by imbibing his own homemade moonshine, a concoction so fierce he compares its aftermath to an entire brigade of siege engines rolling across his skull. Unfortunately for Foggy, one drink too many caused him to pass out during his shift. With Longbraid the Grim commanding the dwarves defending the Span, Foggy cannot afford any further lapses in discipline.

sections.title: A Race Against the Clock
sections.body: Compounding Foggy's troubles is a longstanding debt owed to Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore. Foggy promised Bilger a batch of his personal brew to balance the books, but between his hangover and his shift duties, he finds himself minutes away from default. Relying on gryphons and swift feet, travelers must race across the Arathi Highlands to Southshore to deliver the jug before Bilger decides Foggy has skipped out on his tab once again.

faq.answer: Foggy MacKreel is a dwarf found on the broken part of the Thandol Span, reached from the Arathi Highlands side. Known for brewing extremely stout homemade moonshine, he tends to sample his own product a little too freely while on duty.

faq.q: Why is this delivery so urgent?
faq.answer: Foggy ran severely behind schedule after passing out drunk during his watch. He has a strict deadline to deliver the moonshine to Brewmeister Bilger to settle an overdue tab, leaving barely a quarter of an hour to make the journey from the Thandol Span to Southshore.

Brewmeister Bilger is a master dwarven brewer who plies his trade in the coastal settlement of Southshore within the Hillsbrad Foothills. He appreciates stout alcohol and has an outstanding business agreement with Foggy MacKreel.

faq.q: How does one get the moonshine to Southshore in time?
faq.answer: There is no boat from the Span to Southshore. The quickest route is to head into the Arathi Highlands and take a gryphon from Refuge Pointe to Southshore if you know that flight path, then find Brewmeister Bilger in town before the timer expires.

Longbraid the Grim is the dwarf commander stationed outside Dun Modr in the Wetlands, leading the defenders of the Thandol Span. Foggy lives in absolute dread of Longbraid discovering that he drank himself unconscious while supposed to be on watch.

angles.text: Dwarves will immediately understand the double jeopardy of an agonizing hangover and an unpaid brewing debt owed to a fellow kinsman.
This quick overland run highlights the vital connection between the Thandol Span and Alliance-held Southshore in Hillsbrad.
